title: A notes API from an empty repository, in two milestones
request: Build me a small notes API with Express in TypeScript. A note has a title and a body. I want to create a note, list the notes, read one and delete one. A note must have a title (400 if it is missing or blank), a missing note is a 404, and ids count up and are never reused. Add tests.

hidden.command: npm install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error >/dev/null 2>&1; npx vitest run src/notes.hidden.test.ts --reporter=junit --outputFile="$E2E_REPORT"

files.PLAN.md:
# Notes API

## Milestones

- M1: notes store, create and list
- M2: read one, delete one

spec.name: Notes API
spec.summary: A small REST API for notes: create, list, read and delete, in Express and TypeScript.
users: developers who want a notes service

features.name: Create and list notes
features.description: POST /notes with a required title, GET /notes

risks: Notes live in memory and are lost on a restart
assumptions: No persistence is needed in the first version

scenario.default: Just start: use your best judgement and keep it small.

validated.note: fails before, passes with the oracle's patch
